svg.title: How Chaos-to-Model works
svg.desc: Six stages on one Mac. 1. Ingest: Hash and keep every original. Parsers run in a macOS sandbox, so a hostile file stays contained. 2. Read: Layout-aware parsing. Hard pages are re-read by vision OCR; when readers disagree, a person decides. 3. Curate: Repair Korean line breaks and tables, group editions into works, find duplicates, flag personal data. 4. Generate: Grounded Q&A, rephrases and preference pairs from a local model, each checked against its passage. 5. Export: A rights profile decides what ships: Parquet shards, dataset card, lineage and a signed manifest. 6. Measure: Tune a small student on the export and score it on works it never saw, at a fixed budget. Lineage travels with every row: source file hash, page, box, and every step and model that touched it.
